title: Vera sets up and tunes a Space's booking hours from plain words

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-21: setup is three forms (hours, services, rules), and BOOK-001 shows what happens when an owner has to type a technical value. Vera has no tool for setSpaceAvailability or setSpaceSchedule. Fix: 'I see clients Tuesday to Thursday 10 to 4, hour sessions, nothing before noon on Fridays' becomes windows, services and rules shown back for one tap to save. Later: Vera suggests changes from what gets booked (the Reclaim and SavvyCal idea of protecting focus time and clustering sessions).

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
